_README: IBKR conids for LSE lines, resolved OUT OF BAND via the IBKR MCP search_contracts tool and merged into LSE_SHELF.json by lse_shelf.py. Key = the Yahoo symbol (TIDM + '.L'); the TIDM alone also resolves. A MISSING entry means 'not yet verified', never 'not executable'. LSE trading permission on this account is VERIFIED from the position blotter itself (BRBY @LSE and TW. @LSE are held in GBP), not assumed. NOTE: the 'III' line in the blotter is the US ticker (Information Services Group, USD) and is NOT 3i Group of London - do not read it as an LSE position.

ACSO.L.note: IBKR also carries ACSO.TEN (a TENDER corporate-action line) and two subscribed-rights lines on CORPACT - check for a live tender/return-of-capital before treating the screen multiple as a clean entry
